LEAD77-unit2-freshness-vs-four_term-accu.classification_evidence: No mechanism closure or detecting positive control established; conditional historical availability and fixed-prediction week-block uncertainty.
LEAD77-unit2-freshness-vs-four_term-accu.description: Chronology-purged quote-freshness correction versus four_term; positive means improvement in accuracy_points.
LEAD77-unit2-freshness-vs-four_term-accu.notes: Historical opener proxy, conditional provider availability; 158 reporting looks within 162 ceiling, one primary freshness versus four-term accuracy contrast. Nine correlated contrasts are not independent evidence.
LEAD77-unit2-freshness-vs-four_term-accu.plain_summary: Older sportsbook prices were compared with recently updated prices before the pick deadline. This check does not establish that quote age should change the current pool picks.
